title: Music and musical instruments
descriptionFa: اسم سازها، نوازنده‌ها، سبک‌های موسیقی، و حرف زدن درباره‌ی موسیقی.

words.example: Her uncle is a musician. He plays the tar and the setar.
words.tipFa: music غیرقابل‌شمارشه (نه musics)؛ musical صفته؛ musician آدمه.

words.example: The piano is my favourite musical instrument.
My daughter practises the piano every evening.
words.tipFa: ساز زدن با the: play the piano, play the guitar.

words.example: He's learning the guitar from videos online.
The violin is smaller than the cello.
The cello has a deep, warm sound.
The flute sounds a little like a bird.
My cousin plays the clarinet in the school band.
The trumpet is a very loud instrument!
Our neighbour's son plays the drums every night!
She wants to be a pianist when she grows up.
The violinist played a beautiful solo.
words.tipFa: برای بعضی سازها -player می‌گیم: flute-player, trumpet-player.

words.example: The Tehran Symphony Orchestra played Beethoven last night.
My brother plays in a band with his friends.
I have lessons with a music teacher twice a week.
words.tipFa: با اسم ساز: I have piano lessons.

words.example: This is my favourite song by Googoosh.
The concert starts at eight, so don't be late.
I listen to classical music when I study.
We went to the opera in Vienna.
Most teenagers listen to pop music.
Kurdish folk music is full of energy.
There's live jazz at the café on Thursdays.
My dad still loves rock from the 1970s.
I can't stand loud music in restaurants.
words.tipFa: بعدش اسم یا فعل ing دار: I can't stand waiting.

gapQuestions.sentence: My sister plays the ___. There's a big black one in our living room.
gapQuestions.hintFa: ساز با کلیدهای سیاه و سفید.
